title: Late-Return Fee Table — Bluegate Moving Truck Rental
content:
For each Bluegate Moving Truck Rental class the late-return figures are: a grace period in elapsed hours after the scheduled return time before a late-return fee applies, a fee for each started hour after that grace period, the number of elapsed hours late (counted from the scheduled return time) after which a full extra rental period is charged in place of hourly late fees, and the charge for one extra rental period.

| Vehicle class | Grace period (elapsed hours) | Late-return fee per started hour after the grace period (USD) | Extra period charged once late by more than (elapsed hours) | Extra rental period charge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | 1 | 10.00 | 4 | 19.95 |
| Bluegate Cargo Van | 1 | 10.00 | 4 | 24.95 |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck | 1 | 15.00 | 4 | 29.95 |
| Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck | 1 | 15.00 | 4 | 39.95 |
| Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck | 1 | 20.00 | 4 | 39.95 |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | 1 | 20.00 | 4 | 49.95 |

## Points of reading

- The grace period is 1 elapsed hour and the extra-period threshold is 4 elapsed hours for every class; only the hourly fee and the extra-period charge vary.
- The hourly fee is 10.00 on the Bluegate Pickup Truck and Bluegate Cargo Van, 15.00 on the 10 ft and 15 ft trucks, and 20.00 on the 20 ft and 26 ft trucks.
- Both thresholds are elapsed hours measured from the scheduled return date and time.
